about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle: Where two culinary cultures meet
about.heritage_text: Founded in 2023, Namaste GIEN was born from the passion of uniting India's millennial culinary traditions with the Loire Valley's gastronomic excellence. Each dish tells a story of travel, spices, and craftsmanship.
about.philosophy_text: We select local ingredients and spices imported directly from India to create authentic fusion cuisine. Our farm products come from regional producers, and our spices are freshly ground every day.
about.team_text: Our chef combines twenty years of Indian cuisine experience with training at France's finest establishments.
